name: LifeThreateningWeightRelatedConditions
title: Life-Threatening Weight-Related Conditions
description: Terms for obesity-caused conditions treated by expert societies as life-threatening or organ-threatening and used for VA WMM Tier 1a. Includes obesity hypoventilation syndrome (OHS / Pickwickian syndrome), per the ATS 2019 OHS clinical practice guideline, and idiopathic intracranial hypertension (IIH / pseudotumor cerebri), per the AACE 2014 Advanced Framework for obesity as a chronic disease. Codes were verified with VSAC $lookup. OHS codes are the obesity-specific subset of CMS DRLS Hypoventilation Disorder (OID 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1219.121); that grouping is not downloaded wholesale because it also contains congenital, neuromuscular, and substance-induced hypoventilation. No VSAC value set is dedicated to IIH. Excludes generic obstructive sleep apnea, MASLD, HFpEF, cardiovascular disease, non-obesity hypoventilation codes (G47.34, G47.35, G47.36), and morbid-obesity BMI diagnosis codes.

Terms for obesity-caused conditions treated by expert societies as life-threatening or organ-threatening and used for VA WMM Tier 1a. Includes obesity hypoventilation syndrome (OHS / Pickwickian syndrome), per the ATS 2019 OHS clinical practice guideline, and idiopathic intracranial hypertension (IIH / pseudotumor cerebri), per the AACE 2014 Advanced Framework for obesity as a chronic disease. Codes were verified with VSAC $lookup. OHS codes are the obesity-specific subset of CMS DRLS Hypoventilation Disorder (OID 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1219.121); that grouping is not downloaded wholesale because it also contains congenital, neuromuscular, and substance-induced hypoventilation. No VSAC value set is dedicated to IIH. Excludes generic obstructive sleep apnea, MASLD, HFpEF, cardiovascular disease, non-obesity hypoventilation codes (G47.34, G47.35, G47.36), and morbid-obesity BMI diagnosis codes.
